sources.title: Fine-Tuning-LLM-for-Verilog-Code-Generation - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project fine-tunes bigcode/starcoder2-3b using LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) on the RTL-PP dataset (11,730 instruction-code pairs) to generate syntactically correct, synthesizable Verilog/RTL code from natural-language circuit descriptions. The fine-tuned model doubles the compilation rate of the base model on medium/hard tasks while training only 0.30% of parameters (~9M out of 3B).
